rule: latency passes when infer() P50 < p50_ms * (1 + margin), one-sided: a faster run always passes. infer() is the full served call: VAE encode, proprio, CUDA Graph replay of prefill and the 10-step denoise loop, denormalize, D2H copy. A baseline describes ONE configuration: each precision holds named configuration entries and a run is compared with the entry of its own configuration name only (the gate derives the name from the run's resolved options). An entry with p50_ms null is unseeded, and a run whose configuration has no entry or no name is not compared with any other entry: the latency is reported ungated, with the reason and the measured P50, never passed silently (--require-latency turns it into blocked).
config_terms: `config` is the configuration an entry describes, in the terms of the `effective_config` line (config_resolver.format_effective_config): text_trim (true/false); use_fa4 and use_fa4_mot (true/false, or "auto" = FA4 where the machine can run it, the cuBLAS chain elsewhere and after a capture-time fallback, which matches any resolved value); vae ("torch" = vae_encoder torch, outside the graph; "native_graph" = vae_encoder native, vae_graph true).
